ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel distribution across approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/light gray) mottled clusters accounting for roughly 15% concentrated near the trailing edge and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast light-colored mottling is concentrated along the inner trailing edges and surrounding the median notch. Small, distinct circular white clusters are distributed across the lower central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; approximate pixel angle is acute (60-70 degrees).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high-frequency serrations with irregular amplitudes; notable jagged peaks and deep micro-notches present along the entire boundary of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning into slightly tapered, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of 6-8 circular high-intensity pixel groups located in the medial section of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle scar patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of at least three parallel, light-colored linear disruptions on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular contour loss on the far-left and far-right distal tips (jagged amputations or trauma); numerous circular depigmented scars distributed across the mid-ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Ventral base and peduncle transition is partially occluded by high-intensity pixel noise representing water spray and turbulence.
